summary: Iteration 4 (Live Season Countdown + CSV Export) tested end-to-end. All backend endpoints and all frontend features verified working. Login/regression sanity confirmed.
passed: POST /api/seasons with end_date returns 200 and echoes end_date field
PATCH /api/seasons/{id} with only end_date updates the season and returns 200
GET /api/exports/matches.csv returns 200 with Content-Type text/csv, Content-Disposition attachment, correct header row, and one row per (match x player) (143 lines)
GET /api/exports/matches.csv?season_id=... filters correctly (returns header + 0 data rows for new empty season)
GET /api/exports/leaderboard.csv returns 200 with correct header and one row per player (11 lines)
Login as admin@arenaops.gg via /api/auth/login and via UI (Initiate Session button)
Dashboard: season-countdown card renders and ticks every second (text changes between reads)
Seasons page: season-name-input and season-end-input (type=datetime-local) both present
Seasons page: created new season with end_date and it appears with season-countdown-compact ('14d 23h 58m') on the card
Seasons page: 4 season-edit-{id} pencils rendered; clicking one reveals a season-save-end-{id} save button
Matches page: matches-export-csv anchor exists with href https://.../api/exports/matches.csv
Leaderboard page: leaderboard-export-csv anchor exists with href https://.../api/exports/leaderboard.csv (with active season_id appended)
notes: CSV endpoints correctly mounted on the app (outside api_router) but path /api/exports/... routes via ingress. Countdown compact testid is 'season-countdown-compact' (initial script used wrong name; corrected and verified 2 elements present).
